NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Aim for 1.6..2.2 g protein per kg bodyweight daily from lean sources; distribute across 3..5 meals"
    - "Prioritize omega-3 rich fish 2..3 times per week (e.g., salmon, sardines); if not, consider fish oil per medical guidance)"
    - "Build plates around colorful vegetables and fruits (5+ servings/day), legumes, whole grains"
    - "Choose olive oil, nuts, seeds, and avocado for fats; limit ultra-processed seed oils"
    - "Limit ultra-processed foods, refined sugars, and excessive alcohol; cap alcohol at 0..2 drinks/week"
    - "Hydration: target 30..35 ml/kg/day water; add electrolytes on longer or hot training days"
    - "Include probiotic and prebiotic foods (yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, oats, beans) to support gut health"
    - "Spice regularly with turmeric, ginger, garlic, cinnamon; pair turmeric with black pepper"
    - "Evening meal: include slow-digesting protein and magnesium-rich foods (leafy greens, legumes) to support recovery"
    - "Caffeine: limit to <300 mg/day; avoid within 8 hours of bedtime"
  MEAL_TEMPLATES:
    - "Training days: 3 meals + 1 snack. Pre-workout (1..2h): carbs 1..2 g/kg + protein 20..40 g, low fat/fiber. Post-workout (0..2h): protein 30..40 g + carbs 1 g/kg"
    - "Rest days: 3 meals. Keep protein constant; reduce carbs slightly and increase vegetables and healthy fats"
  MICROFOCUS:

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Aim for 1.6..2.2 g protein per kg bodyweight daily from lean sources; distribute across 3..5 meals"
    - "Prioritize omega-3 rich fish 2..3 times per week (e.g., salmon, sardines); if not, consider fish oil per medical guidance)"
    - "Build plates around colorful vegetables and fruits (5+ servings/day), legumes, whole grains"
    - "Choose olive oil, nuts, seeds, and avocado for fats; limit ultra-processed seed oils"
    - "Limit ultra-processed foods, refined sugars, and excessive alcohol; cap alcohol at 0..2 drinks/week"
    - "Hydration: target 30..35 ml/kg/day water; add electrolytes on longer or hot training days"
    - "Include probiotic and prebiotic foods (yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, oats, beans) to support gut health"
    - "Spice regularly with turmeric, ginger, garlic, cinnamon; pair turmeric with black pepper"
    - "Evening meal: include slow-digesting protein and magnesium-rich foods (leafy greens, legumes) to support recovery"
    - "Caffeine: limit to <300 mg/day; avoid within 8 hours of bedtime"
  MEAL_TEMPLATES:
    - "Training days: 3 meals + 1 snack. Pre-workout (1..2h): carbs 1..2 g/kg + protein 20..40 g, low fat/fiber. Post-workout (0..2h): protein 30..40 g + carbs 1 g/kg"
    - "Rest days: 3 meals. Keep protein constant; reduce carbs slightly and increase vegetables and healthy fats"
  MICROFOCUS:
    - "Daily omega-3 target ~1..2 g EPA+DHA from food/supplement as advised by a clinician"
    - "Fiber 25..40 g/day from varied plants to support systemic inflammation control"
  CHECKPOINTS:
    - "Week 1: establish baseline intake and hydration; track protein and produce servings"
    - "Week 4: add fish 2..3x/week and turmeric/ginger daily; review digestion and energy"
    - "Week 8: tighten ultra-processed food limit to <10% of calories; alcohol 0..1 drinks/week"
    - "Week 12: maintain habits; plan next 4 weeks with same structure"

RECOVERY
  SLEEP:
    - "Aim 7.5..9 hours in bed nightly; keep a fixed wake time even on weekends"
    - "Wind-down routine 45..60 minutes: dim lights, shower, light reading; avoid screens blue light"
    - "Caffeine cutoff: 8 hours before bedtime; alcohol: avoid or limit to occasional single drink and not within 3 hours of sleep"
    - "Bedroom: cool 17..19 C, dark, quiet; consider eye mask and white noise"
    - "If unable to sleep after 20 minutes, get up, low-light reading, return when sleepy"
    - "Short nap 10..20 minutes before 3 pm on heavy training days if needed"
  RECOVERY_PROTOCOLS:
    - "Daily 5..10 minutes breathing: nasal, slow exhales, or box breathing post-training"
    - "Walking 10..20 minutes on rest days to promote blood flow and low-back comfort"
    - "Mobility: cat_cow 2x8, child_pose 2x30 seconds, hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 seconds each side after training"
    - "Heat 10..15 minutes or warm shower for stiffness; ice only for acute flare-ups per clinician"
    - "Elevate legs 5..10 minutes after long desk days to reduce stiffness"
    - "Step target 6,000..8,000/day in Phase 1, 8,000..10,000/day in Phases 2..3"
  MONITORING:
    - "Track morning energy 1..5, sleep hours, RPE of key lifts, and back comfort (0..10) daily"
    - "If back comfort >3 or sharp pain appears: stop provocative movement, substitute leg_press for goblet_squat or reduce load 10..20%"
    - "Autoregulation: if sleep <6 hours or morning energy <=2, reduce session volume by 20% and keep RPE <=7"
    - "During Week 12 testing: take rest day between lower and bench tests, keep cardio easy (Zone 1..2) and stop if any back discomfort increases"
